column39:
Everyone can tell that you are a very enthusiastic lecturer and love your job. That’s a reallyyy good thing and it makes a big difference for students! I know my friends and I had some of our biggest laughs in this classroom. (I’m sorry again about the “Croissant” thing—I swear I didn’t do it on purpose…it’s a long story). 

All my reasons for the dissatisfaction in this course are that I’ve already studied all the content many times in my bachelor’s (Nanobiology with a minor in AI), with about 50 ECTS dedicated to coding and data analysis… and since the Master prerequisites asked for “advanced Python programming,” I’ll admit the first lab of this course where we learned about Python variables and arrays etc frustrated me. The course was not challenging enough to be fun for me. But it was very fun because of you, the professor (I went to all the lectures still!). So thank you :)
